body.title: Integrate qualified Claude investigation sessions
body.summary: Implement the Claude-specific isolated invocation adapter behind LLMProvider/CliProvider using the common bridge and qualification boundary.
acceptanceChecks: Qualified invocation exposes only the scoped bridge and supports multiple per-block ACKs in one managed CLI session.
128K inclusive estimated admission includes actual schema/tool catalogue and reserves; internalRetry:false, 5-minute cap and abort/stall behavior retain existing owner accounting.
No-binding legacy/design invocation behavior remains unchanged; unqualified installed versions fail closed without broad-tool fallback or direct REST.

tests.name: Claude scoped session progress budget cancellation and legacy behavior
